title: Reconcile a roster against bank payments
prompt: members.csv (id, name, annual_fee) is our roster and payments.csv (member_id, paid_by, amount_paid, date) is the bank export; they should cover the same members at the same amounts but do not. Write report.json with three sorted lists of member ids: only_in_members (on the roster, no payment row), only_in_payments (paid but not on the roster) and amount_mismatch (in both, amounts differing by a cent or more). The bank export is messy: ids vary in case and spacing, and amounts may carry a $ sign or thousands commas. Match ids ignoring case and surrounding spaces, compare amounts as numbers, and write ids upper-case like M-007. Leave both CSVs as they are.
